recognize_zh: 下方為淡染、顆粒狀的壞死區，壞死邊緣有一圈細長、放射狀排列的柵欄狀組織球，外層是淋巴球浸潤帶，上方可見纖維化被膜；此分層結構符合貓抓病的壞死性肉芽腫。
features: Central pale granular necrotic zone with fibrinous debris at the lower field
Band of elongated epithelioid histiocytes palisading radially around the necrosis
Outer cuff of dense small lymphocytes
Fibrotic, vascularized capsular/perinodal tissue in the upper left
Focal hemorrhage at the edge of the necrotic area
describe_en: Lymph node section shows a zonated necrotizing granuloma. A central zone of pale granular necrosis is bordered by a layer of palisading epithelioid histiocytes, which is in turn surrounded by a cuff of small lymphocytes and fibrotic capsular tissue. Neutrophils within the necrotic center cannot be clearly resolved at this magnification. Findings are consistent with necrotizing granulomatous lymphadenitis, compatible with cat scratch disease; confirmation requires Warthin-Starry staining, serology, or PCR for Bartonella henselae.

ddx.vs: Caseating granulomas typically contain Langhans giant cells and lack stellate suppurative centers, with positive AFB stain or culture.
Kikuchi necrosis is karyorrhectic and paracortical with crescentic histiocytes, without neutrophils or palisading epithelioid histiocytes.
LGV produces identical stellate abscesses, so separation depends on inguinal location and Chlamydia serology or PCR.
